baseline.input_law: Public known-answer targets generated separately; solver APIs receive nine public lines and no scalar.

planned_panel.arm_order: Interleave a preregistered permutation within each target/round block; no cross-target tables or retained algebraic setup.

accounting.requested_primary: Complete cold pipeline wall time through recovery and source verification, including setup, failed chart choices and retries.
accounting.reusable_setup: Record separately; never substitute amortized or target-only cost for the requested cold total.
accounting.online_interval: Do not relabel a mixed setup interval as online time. A separate online result requires explicit native phase instrumentation.
accounting.partial_counters: Retain each native target-call M/I/NAT/LA scope. These are not complete FLINT/Singular or whole-pipeline GAE prices.
accounting.performance_admission: Requires the frozen experiment.protocol/v1, actual per-execution L2 observations, A/A admission, source checks, independent replay and applicable full native pricing.

launch_gates: Obtain an existing authorized operator role/runner or the documented scoped launch and image-publication permissions; do not grant access from this session.
Read current daily/monthly budgets and charged/reserved spending; verify live NodePool and namespace quota headroom.
Finish the standalone native measured-command integration, preserving the actual source-to-Jacobian pipeline and refusing absent isolation evidence.
Complete the strongest-applicable-source-reference review and native phase/pricing obligations before freezing comparative claims.
Validate and freeze experiment.protocol/v1 and its native analysis before affected timing data; disclose the earlier correctness pilots.
Push exact source, inputs, protocol and launch configuration, retain check-experiment-git receipt, and pass the official S3 checkpoint gate.
Build/publish one source-bound digest image and submit the exact immutable request once; reconcile ambiguous submissions by original identity.
Retain and hash all raw outputs, failures, Job/Pod identities and resource observations; do not treat command-job success as L2 admission.
